_class_why: byte-exact twin of the DLL patch `net_resync_wait_fix` -- the corpus's other registered patch collision.
_comment: Fixes the MP client permanent-hang root-caused from mh_hang.dmp (Win11Gen1 VM, 2026-07-10; tasks/mp-restoration.md). llm_net_lockstep_sync_busywait (0x0049e29d) is a hard GetTickCount busy-wait (no message pump) whose duration comes from llm_net_lockstep_sync_delay_stub (0x0049bbd4) -- a dead/cut-MP stub that returns an UNINITIALIZED stack local (confirmed in disasm + the Ghidra decompiler: `return CONCAT44(param_2, local_2c)`, local_2c never written). When the lockstep stall-recovery resync fires (leader's LEADER_STALL_COUNTER > players*100, tripped by VM frame-hitches -> horizon stall), both peers process the type-4/0xd resync record and enter this busy-wait; the garbage delay (~6.1M ms / ~102 min in the dump) makes the main thread spin forever while holding game CS 0x0064461b -> Windows 'not responding'. FIX: patch the stub's `mov eax,[ebp-0x28]` (8B 45 D8 at 0x0049bbec) to `xor eax,eax; nop` (31 C0 90) so it returns 0. Then the busy-wait computes deadline=now+0 and exits immediately (returns 1='waited ok'), and the '<0' error gate in llm_strat_session_begin_multi (0x0045450e) sees a non-error 0. Safe: the stub never returned a meaningful value (the sync-wait was always broken; retail never reached it), the lockstep is proven bit-deterministic (A3), and the resync's real recovery work (rebaseline timestamp, re-advertise horizon, broadcast, llm_strat_time_resync_and_tick) still runs -- only the broken wait is neutralized. No whole-file sha256 pin: chain this AFTER net_load + cd_audio_nonfatal (they touch different regions); the per-patch 'expect' byte guard is the safety check. Run: python mhpatch.py apply mh.mp.tmp2.exe net_resync_wait_fix.mh.patch.json mh.mp.exe
target: mh.exe (English, F:/games/mh_en) -- EN-native port of net_resync_wait_fix
